doc.name: SIRIUS
doc.title: THE DOG STAR
doc.blurb: The brightest star in the night, twice the Sun and 8.6 light-years off, in a big white glow, with the Pup, a white dwarf the size of Earth, pale blue on a fifty-second eccentric hoop (one second = one year) that swings in close and races past; the line between them is the leash. Mirzam the Announcer rises just ahead of it. The eye is Sirius itself.
doc.where: SS_QUICK_POOL @279: append 'sirius'. No act unless Wyatt seats it (CANIS the spare carries it at the throat).
